tasks.description: packages/shared: ClaudeCodeAccountSchema gains required `id` slug; rename runtimes.claudeCode.activeAccount -> defaultAccount (semver-keyed config migration carrying the value and backfilling unique ids from label/path basename); AgentManifestSchema gains account?: string with .catch(undefined); AgentManifestUpdate/UpdateAgentRequestSchema gain account?: string|null; SendMessageRequestSchema gains account?: string; ServerConfigSchema.claudeCode.accounts[] rows gain id: string|null. apps/server: resolveLaunchAccountRoot ladder (hint id -> agent id -> defaultAccount path -> env/default) feeding claudeConfigDirEnv; launch-resolver uses session.accountRoot ?? resolveLaunchAccountRoot; hint rides POST /messages like the runtime hint, honored only on the session-creating claude-code send; rename fallout in claude-config-dir.ts, describeClaudeCodeAccounts (adds ids), config-write-policy, config-disclosure, safe-defaults (defaultAccount stays operator-only); agent-manifest `account` writes rejected/stripped on agent-reachable surfaces (MCP tools) while the client HTTP route accepts it.
